en.title: Military aircraft crashed seconds after takeoff: Two pilots escaped at last moment
en.summary: A British Royal Air Force T2 Hawk training aircraft crashed moments after takeoff in the Anglesey region of North Wales, with both pilots managing to escape.

stories.title: Fon soruşturmasında yeni gelişme... Tera yöneticileri Kerem ve Emre Alkin'in ifadeleri ortaya çıktı

en.title: New developments in fund investigation... Statements from Tera executives Kerem and Emre Alkin emerge
en.summary: Statements given by Kerem Alkin and Emre Alkin, independent board members at Tera Group companies, have emerged in a fund investigation conducted by Istanbul's chief prosecutor's office. Prosecutors questioned how Tera Yatırım's market value increased from approximately 1.4 billion lira to 280 billion lira within a year, and also investigated the brothers' resignations one day apart before the fund crisis.

stories.title: Ankara CHP’den istifa eden belediye başkanları kimler? İşte isim isim liste...

en.title: Which mayors from Ankara CHP resigned? Here is the list by name...
en.summary: Following Ankara Mayor Mansur Yavaş's resignation from the CHP, a wave of resignations accelerated within the party. Eight mayors from Beypazarı, Kalecik, Güdül, Polatlı, Ayaş, Şereflikoçhisar, Elmadağ, and Nallıhan resigned from the CHP immediately after Yavaş's announcement.

stories.title: İngiliz savaş uçağı havalandıktan saniyeler sonra düştü

en.title: British fighter jet crashed seconds after takeoff
en.summary: A T2 Hawk training aircraft belonging to the British Royal Air Force crashed shortly after taking off from RAF Valley Base in Wales. Both pilots ejected and survived with minor injuries.

en.summary: In the fund investigation, Tera Yatırım Holding Chairman Emre Tezmen and four executives were arrested. Tezmen's statement in the investigation has surfaced.

en.summary: Bayram Özbek, a screenwriter for the TV series Kurtlar Vadisi, has been detained in connection with an investigation into Kaşif Kozinoğlu on charges related to founding or managing an armed terror organization and incitement to murder.

stories.title: Dünyanın borcu 365 trilyon doları aştı: Kamu ve şirket borçları yeni zirveyi gördü

en.title: World debt exceeds 365 trillion dollars: Public and corporate debt reach new highs
en.summary: Global debt reached 365.5 trillion dollars in the first half of 2026, increasing by over 10 trillion dollars. According to the International Finance Institute, public debt and non-financial corporate borrowing drove the increase, while rising interest costs intensified fiscal pressures in developed economies.

stories.title: İTO Başkanı Avdagiç'ten küresel ticaret mesajı: Türkiye yeni dönemde büyük avantaja sahip

en.title: ITO President Avdagiç's global trade message: Turkey has major advantages in new era
en.summary: The Istanbul Chamber of Commerce president stated that protectionist policies, geopolitical tensions, and supply chain disruptions are straining global trade. He highlighted that Turkey possesses significant advantages including strong infrastructure, skilled workforce, and favorable logistics positioning.

en.title: Istanbul Stock Exchange closed the day with gains
